report_md:
# Report: quarter-end rebalancing flow — the 2+2 session window

**Strategy:** `family-quarter-end-flow`
**Window:** development only, 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29, 1-minute marks, next-open
fills, 2% band, idle BIL.
**Bar:** TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe (brief). The panel's
1 bp TQQQ buy-and-hold is 36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80.

## Verdict

**Negative — the family is rejected.** The centre (50% TQQQ base, 100% in the
last two sessions of a quarter plus the first two sessions of the next quarter)
earns **25.86% CAGR / 53.81% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe at 1 bp** and **24.72% /
54.16% / 0.80 at 10 bp**. It is 10.9 pp below the CAGR bar. More importantly,
the **shifted +5-session placebo beats it**: 30.07% / 61.01% / 0.92 at 1 bp,
28.87% at 10 bp. A window one week later is better than the real quarter-end
window, so the "quarter-end flow" clock is not identified. The window-only
version earns 4.29% and is below the repo's 5% viability floor. The constant
53.2%-TQQQ control earns 25.54% with a 55.75% DD — almost exactly the centre —
so the window tilt adds only **+0.32 pp CAGR and -1.94 pp DD**. The 2+2 window
is not a special clock; the result is a generic 50/50 risk profile.

## 1. What the strategy does

For each calendar quarter, the window is:

- the last two regular sessions of March, June, September and December;
- plus the first two regular sessions of January, April, July and October.

For each session:

```
w_tqqq(k) = 1.00   if k is in the 2+2 quarter-end window
          = 0.50   otherwise
w_bil(k)  = 1 - w_tqqq(k)
```

- The window is known from the calendar at the prior close. The target for the
  first window session is set at the previous close and filled at the next
  open; the exit target (0.50) is set at the last window session's close and
  filled at the next open. The harness's next-open rule is used unchanged.
- Idle is BIL. The cash-idle version is not reported separately because the
  turnover is low (258x) and BIL is the natural idle asset.
- No trend SMA, no realised vol, no drawdown state, no cross-sectional signal,
  no quarter-return conditioning in the centre. The centre is deliberately
  **unconditional**: the claim is that the calendar window itself has a
  positive flow, not that a strong quarter predicts the next one.

## 2. Headline development result

| cost | CAGR | max DD | Sharpe | Sortino | vol | ending equity |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 bp | **25.86%** | **53.81%** | **0.82** | 1.15 | 35.9% | $628k |
| 5 bp | 25.36% | 53.88% | 0.81 | 1.13 | 35.9% | $608k |
| 10 bp | 24.72% | 54.16% | 0.80 | 1.11 | 35.9% | $583k |
| TQQQ | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 1.12 | 66.5% | $1.175m |

| cost | fills | turnover |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 bp | 1,025 | 258.0x |
| 5 bp | 1,023 | 252.5x |
| 10 bp | 1,027 | 246.2x |

The centre fails the CAGR bar by 10.9 pp. It does cut max DD by 28.5 pp and
roughly matches TQQQ's Sharpe, but that is a lower-risk allocation, not an
above-TQQQ winner. The cost drag is small (-1.14 pp from 1 bp to 10 bp) because
turnover is only 258x.

**Exposure:** mean TQQQ weight **53.2%**; 6.4% of sessions at 100% (the 128
window sessions), 93.6% at 50%. The harness `exposure` field is 100% because
BIL is an asset; the TQQQ weight is the relevant number.

**Drawdown:** 2021-11-22 to 2022-10-13, **-53.81%**. The 50% base halves the
TQQQ drawdown but does not eliminate it.

**Turnover / fills:** 258x, 1,025 fills. Most of the fills are 2%-band
rebalances of the 50/50 book; the window itself adds only 32 round trips.

## 3. The window is not special

Session-level TQQQ open-to-open returns, 2016-2023:

| window | n | mean | t | win rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2+2 quarter-end window | 128 | **+25.7 bp** | **0.84** | 50.8% |
| outside the window | 1,884 | +20.7 bp | 2.15 | 56.0% |
| last 1 session | 32 | +59.0 bp | 0.89 | 56.3% |
| first 1 session | 32 | +28.2 bp | 0.42 | 53.1% |
| last 2 sessions | 64 | +48.5 bp | 1.20 | 54.7% |
| first 2 sessions | 64 | +2.9 bp | 0.06 | 46.9% |
| last 3 sessions | 96 | +18.8 bp | 0.51 | 54.2% |
| first 3 sessions | 96 | +43.6 bp | 1.06 | 53.1% |
| last 4 sessions | 128 | +49.9 bp | 1.52 | 56.3% |
| first 4 sessions | 128 | +67.1 bp | 1.79 | 54.7% |
| **shift +5 sessions** | 127 | **+70.3 bp** | **2.18** | 59.1% |
| shift -5 sessions | 127 | +13.4 bp | 0.38 | 47.2% |

The 2+2 window's mean (+25.7 bp) is only 5.0 bp above the outside mean
(+20.7 bp), and its t-stat is 0.84. The shifted +5-session window is much
stronger: +70.3 bp, t = 2.18. The first two sessions of the new quarter are
flat (+2.9 bp, t = 0.06); the last two are positive but weak (+48.5 bp,
t = 1.20). The positive window mean is not a quarter-end flow; it is a
generic mid-month effect that happens to be stronger one week later.

The quarter breakdown is worse:

| quarter | window mean | t |
|---:|---:|---:|
| Q1 (Mar/Apr) | +47.2 bp | 0.71 |
| Q2 (Jun/Jul) | +121.0 bp | 2.07 |
| Q3 (Sep/Oct) | -18.7 bp | -0.31 |
| Q4 (Dec/Jan) | -46.7 bp | -0.86 |

The full-window mean is carried by Q2; Q3 and Q4 are negative. This is not a
stable quarterly flow.

## 4. Pre-registered grid and placebo

The 8 cells were fixed in `HYPOTHESIS.md` before the final run:

| # | base | window | role | 1 bp CAGR | 1 bp DD | 1 bp Sharpe | 10 bp CAGR |
|---:|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 30% | last 2 + first 2 | base neighbour | 18.17% | 38.37% | 0.80 | 16.81% |
| 2 | **50%** | **last 2 + first 2** | **centre** | **25.86%** | **53.81%** | **0.82** | **24.72%** |
| 3 | 70% | last 2 + first 2 | base neighbour | 31.77% | 67.83% | 0.82 | 31.02% |
| 4 | 90% | last 2 + first 2 | base neighbour | 35.47% | 77.87% | 0.81 | 35.23% |
| 5 | 50% | last 2 only | window neighbour | 26.01% | 58.11% | 0.84 | 24.83% |
| 6 | 50% | first 2 only | window neighbour | 24.03% | 49.09% | 0.80 | 22.91% |
| 7 | 50% | last 2 + first 2, shifted +5 | **placebo** | **30.07%** | **61.01%** | **0.92** | **28.87%** |
| 8 | 0% | last 2 + first 2 | window only | 4.29% | 20.85% | 0.35 | 2.79% |

Every base cell fails the 36.72% CAGR bar; the 90% base is the closest at
35.47% (1.25 pp short of the brief bar, 0.68 pp short of the panel TQQQ) but
has a 77.87% DD. The window-only cell is 4.29%,
below the 5% viability floor. The shifted +5 placebo is the highest-Sharpe
cell in the grid (0.92) and beats the centre on CAGR, DD and Sharpe. This is
the decisive negative result.

## 5. Controls

| variant | CAGR | max DD | Sharpe | comment |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| TQQQ buy & hold | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | bar |
| constant 53.2% TQQQ | 25.54% | 55.75% | 0.82 | same mean weight |
| **centre** | **25.86%** | **53.81%** | **0.82** | window tilt |
| shift -5 sessions | 24.37% | 49.87% | 0.78 | opposite shift |
| de-risk last 2 sessions | 31.60% | 79.69% | 0.75 | negative-flow direction |
| de-risk first 2 after up quarter | 35.01% | 81.70% | 0.79 | conditional momentum |

The constant-exposure control at the same mean weight earns 25.54% with a
55.75% DD. The window tilt adds **+0.32 pp CAGR and -1.94 pp DD**. That is
within noise; the window is not doing meaningful work.

The two rejected alternatives are informative:

1. **De-risk the last two sessions** (the pension-selling direction): 31.60%
   CAGR but a 79.69% DD and 0.75 Sharpe. The data rejects the negative-flow
   direction; quarter-end returns are positive on average, so de-risking them
   costs return and does not reduce the drawdown enough.
2. **De-risk the first two sessions after an up quarter** (a conditional
   momentum/rebalancing rule): 35.01% CAGR, 81.70% DD, 0.79 Sharpe. It is close
   to TQQQ but still below, and it has a much worse DD. It is a momentum
   condition, not the unconditional flow claim, and it is not the centre.

## 6. Placebo

### 6.1 Shifted window (deterministic)

| window | 1 bp CAGR | 1 bp DD | 1 bp Sharpe | 10 bp CAGR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| real 2+2 | 25.86% | 53.81% | 0.82 | 24.72% |
| shifted +5 sessions | **30.07%** | 61.01% | **0.92** | **28.87%** |
| shifted -5 sessions | 24.37% | 49.87% | 0.78 | — |

The +5 shift beats the real window by 4.21 pp CAGR and 0.10 Sharpe. The -5
shift is slightly worse. The real window is not the best calendar window in its
own neighbourhood.

### 6.2 Random 4-session windows

32 random 4-session windows, 1,000 draws, same 50% base:

| | CAGR |
|---|---:|
| real (daily approximation) | 25.84% |
| placebo mean | 24.99% |
| placebo p95 | 30.57% |
| placebo p99 | 32.12% |
| placebo max | 35.00% |
| p-value (draws >= real) | **0.418** |

The real window is at the 58th percentile of random 4-session windows. There is
no evidence that the quarter-end dates are special.

## 7. Sub-periods and yearly behaviour

| period | strategy CAGR | strategy DD | TQQQ CAGR | TQQQ DD |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2016-2019 | 26.47% | 32.39% | 49.67% | 56.77% |
| 2020-2023 | 23.50% | 52.00% | 24.11% | 81.57% |
| **ex-2020** | **25.70%** | **52.00%** | **28.35%** | 81.57% |

| year | strategy | TQQQ |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 2016 | +10.0% | +19.9% |
| 2017 | +48.9% | +114.5% |
| 2018 | -0.1% | -20.8% |
| 2019 | +57.6% | +148.2% |
| 2020 | +76.9% | +104.1% |
| 2021 | +42.6% | +81.1% |
| 2022 | -47.3% | -79.4% |
| 2023 | +83.0% | +192.0% |

The strategy lags TQQQ in every up year and loses less in 2018 and 2022. That
is the expected profile of a 53% TQQQ book, not evidence of a quarter-end flow.
The ex-2020 CAGR (25.70%) is below the TQQQ ex-2020 bar (28.35%).

## 8. Correlations to the nine current winners

Daily-return Pearson correlation, development window only:

| winner | correlation |
|---|---:|
| ratio-froth | 0.607 |
| vol-scaled-crash-stop | 0.778 |
| relative-value-tqqq | 0.873 |
| fomc-opex-window | 0.672 |
| family-session-timing | 0.717 |
| family-short-reversal | 0.871 |
| family-rebalance-flow | 0.854 |
| family-intraday-microstructure-day | 0.592 |
| family-ml-microstructure | 0.849 |

Range **0.592-0.873**, mean **0.757**. This is TQQQ beta with a 50% risk
budget; it is not a diversifier and not an independent clock.

## 9. Causality and no look-ahead

- The quarter-end window is known from the calendar at the prior close. The
  target for the first window session is set at the previous close and filled
  at the next open.
- No quarter-return conditioning, no same-day information, no actual
  rebalancing-flow data.
- No warmup indicator is needed; the first decision is 2016-01-04.
- Truncation test: building weights on the panel ending 2022-01-03 leaves all
  weights through 2021-12-29 unchanged (`prior_weights_unchanged: true`).
- No 2024+ bar is loaded in `strategy.py`; the winner-curve correlations are
  truncated to 2023-12-29 before the return calculation.

## 10. Kill criteria and result

| criterion | result | pass? |
|---|---|---|
| 10 bp CAGR <= 36.72% | 24.72% | **fail** |
| shifted +5 placebo beats the real window | 30.07% vs 25.86% | **fail** |
| window-only CAGR < 5% | 4.29% | **fail** |
| window mean t < 1.0 | t = 0.84 | **fail** |
| real below constant exposure | 25.86% vs 25.54% | pass (barely above) |
| drop best quarter below constant | yes | **fail** |

Five of six criteria fail. The verdict is **negative**. The only criterion
that passes is the constant-exposure comparison, and the margin is +0.32 pp
CAGR with a 1.94 pp DD improvement — not a meaningful edge.

## 11. Limitations

1. **The window is not special.** The +5-session shift is better on CAGR, DD and
   Sharpe. The real window's mean is only 5.0 bp above the outside mean, with
   t = 0.84. The Q3 and Q4 windows are negative.
2. **The window-only strategy is dead.** 4.29% CAGR at 1 bp, 2.79% at 10 bp,
   below the repo's 5% viability floor. The family only survives as a 50% base
   allocation, which is a generic risk profile.
3. **The constant-exposure control is almost identical.** 25.54% vs 25.86% CAGR;
   the tilt adds 0.32 pp. A reader who wants a 50/50 TQQQ/BIL book can get the
   same result without the quarter-end trades.
4. **The conditional momentum alternative is not the claim.** De-risking the
   first two sessions after an up quarter earns 35.01% but has an 81.70% DD and
   is a momentum condition, not an unconditional flow.
5. **The 2+2 definition is a choice.** The grid shows last-2-only (26.01%) and
   first-2-only (24.03%) are similar to the combined window; no component is
   significant.
6. **One cycle.** 32 quarter windows, 128 sessions. The sample is small and the
   quarter-level t-stats are all below 2.1.

## 12. Final verdict

**The family is rejected.** The deliverable is:

- 25.86% CAGR / 53.81% DD / 0.82 Sharpe at 1 bp;
- 24.72% CAGR / 54.16% DD / 0.80 Sharpe at 10 bp;
- 10.9 pp below the CAGR bar;
- shifted +5-session placebo 30.07% / 61.01% / 0.92, better than the real window;
- constant 53.2% TQQQ control 25.54% / 55.75% / 0.82, almost identical;
- window-only 4.29%, below the 5% viability floor;
- random 4-session placebo p = 0.418;
- exact pre-cut weights (causality truncation test passes).

The honest one-line description: *a 50/50 TQQQ/BIL book that doubles TQQQ
exposure for the last two sessions of a quarter and the first two of the next;
the quarter-end window is not distinguishable from a window one week later, and
the tilt adds almost nothing over constant exposure.* It is a valid negative
result, not a winner.
hypothesis_md:
# Hypothesis: quarter-end rebalancing flow — the 2+2 session window

**Slug:** `family-quarter-end-flow`
**Window:** development only, 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29, 1-minute marks.
**Bar:** TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe (brief). The
panel's 1 bp TQQQ buy-and-hold is 36.29% / 81.57% / 0.80.
**Status:** pre-registered before the final `strategy.py` run. No 2024+ bar is
loaded anywhere in this directory.

## 1. Claim

Calendar-quarter ends are a distinct rebalancing clock, different from the
month-end and turn-of-month clocks. Pension funds, target-date funds, insurers
and balanced mandates rebalance back to policy weights at quarter-end. The
flow is mechanical and concentrated in the last two sessions of the quarter
and the first two sessions of the new quarter:

- into quarter-end, the rebalancing demand is usually **buying** equities
  after a strong quarter (the equity share has drifted above target) or
  **selling** after a weak quarter; the sign is conditional on the quarter's
  return, but the unconditional window has historically been positive because
  the average quarter is positive and the window catches the inflow;
- at the start of the new quarter, the flow reverses and the first sessions
  can be weak.

The tested claim is deliberately **unconditional and long-only**: the 2+2
session window has a higher TQQQ open-to-open return than the rest of the
quarter. We do not use the quarter's return sign, because that would turn the
study into a momentum/flow-conditioning strategy and duplicate the trend
family. The strategy is a **positive-flow tilt**: a strategic 50% TQQQ book is
raised to 100% during the window. If the window is not special, the tilt will
not beat a constant-exposure control or a window shifted by one week.

This is **not** a trend, volatility, drawdown, opening-range, close-flow,
relative-strength or ML signal. The only input is the calendar quarter. The
decision is known at the previous close.

## 2. Exact rules (centre)

Universe: QQQ (not used), TQQQ (position), BIL (idle).

For each calendar quarter, the window is:

- the **last two regular sessions** of March, June, September and December;
- plus the **first two regular sessions** of January, April, July and October.

For session `k`:

```
w_tqqq(k) = 1.00   if k is in the 2+2 quarter-end window
          = 0.50   otherwise
w_bil(k)  = 1 - w_tqqq(k)
```

- The window is known from the calendar at the prior close. The target for the
  first window session is set at the previous close and filled at the next
  open; the exit target (0.50) is set at the last window session's close and
  filled at the next open. The harness's next-open rule is used unchanged.
- Idle weight is BIL, not cash.
- The 2% rebalance band is the harness default. Headline cost is 1 bp; 5 bp
  and 10 bp are reported.
- No moving average, no realised vol, no drawdown state, no cross-sectional
  signal, no full-sample normalisation.

## 3. Pre-registered grid (8 cells)

The centre is **base 50%, 2+2 window, full weight in the window**. The grid is
a local neighbourhood plus the required placebo, fixed before the final run:

| # | base weight | window | role |
|---:|---:|---|---|
| 1 | 30% | last 2 + first 2 | base neighbour |
| 2 | **50%** | **last 2 + first 2** | **centre** |
| 3 | 70% | last 2 + first 2 | base neighbour |
| 4 | 90% | last 2 + first 2 | base neighbour |
| 5 | 50% | last 2 only | window neighbour |
| 6 | 50% | first 2 only | window neighbour |
| 7 | 50% | last 2 + first 2, shifted +5 sessions | **placebo** |
| 8 | 0% | last 2 + first 2 | window-only |

Every cell is reported, including the failures. No cell is selected on the
holdout.

## 4. Pilot scan disclosure

A coarse scan of the dev window was run before fixing the grid. It covered:

- last N and first N sessions of the quarter for N = 1..7;
- the 2+2 window and its components;
- base weights 0-100%;
- a window shifted by +5 and -5 sessions;
- a conditional version that de-risks the first two sessions after an up
  quarter (pension selling).

It showed that the 2+2 window is **positive but weak**: last-2 mean +48.7 bp
(t = 1.19), first-2 mean +3.2 bp (t = 0.07), combined window about +26 bp over
four sessions. The window-only strategy earns only 4.3% CAGR and is below the
repo's 5% "dead" floor. The 50% base tilt is the smallest base that keeps the
strategy alive and still gives the window a meaningful 2x exposure step. The
shifted +5-session window is **better** than the real window (11.75% vs 4.29%
window-only; 30.07% vs 25.86% at base 50%), which is the central negative
result. The conditional pension-selling version de-risks the first two
sessions after an up quarter and earns 36.9% gross, but it is a momentum
condition, not the unconditional flow claim, and it is not the delivered
centre. The pilot also produced two rejected ideas reported in `report.md`:

1. **De-risk the last two sessions** (the pension-selling direction): 19.7%
   at 1 bp with an 85% DD. The data rejects the negative-flow direction.
2. **Window-only**: 4.29% CAGR, below the 5% floor. It is not a viable
   standalone.

## 5. Falsification criteria

The hypothesis is rejected if any of the following holds on the dev window:

1. Centre 10 bp CAGR <= 36.72% (the family is expected to fail this).
2. The shifted +5-session placebo beats the real window on 1 bp CAGR and
   Sharpe.
3. The window-only strategy earns less than 5% CAGR (it is effectively dead).
4. The 2+2 window's conditional mean is not positive (t < 1.0).
5. The real window's 1 bp CAGR is below the constant-exposure control at the
   same average TQQQ weight.
6. The window is a single-quarter artefact: removing the best quarter drops
   the centre below the constant-exposure control.

Criterion 2 is the decisive placebo. Criterion 3 is the activity/viability
test. If the shifted window is better, the "quarter-end flow" interpretation
is not identified and the family must be rejected even if the base-50%
strategy has a respectable Sharpe.

## 6. What would make this a real holdout candidate

The strategy is a 50/50 TQQQ/BIL book that doubles equity exposure for four
sessions around each quarter boundary. It should have a lower drawdown than
TQQQ (roughly 50-55% vs 82%) at a materially lower CAGR (roughly 25% vs 36%).
It is a candidate for the one-shot holdout only if the window tilt adds
something over a constant 56% TQQQ control *and* the shifted-window placebo is
worse. If the shifted window is better, the honest verdict is "quarter-end is
not a special clock; the result is a generic 50/50 risk profile."

code:
"""Quarter-end rebalancing flow: 50% base, full TQQQ in the 2+2 session window.

Standalone strategy, development window only (2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29).

Rules
-----
For each calendar quarter, the window is the last two regular sessions of
March/June/September/December plus the first two regular sessions of
January/April/July/October.  For session k:

    w_tqqq(k) = 1.00   if k is in the 2+2 quarter-end window
              = 0.50   otherwise
    w_bil(k)  = 1 - w_tqqq(k)

The window is known from the calendar at the prior close.  The target for the
first window session is set at the previous close and filled at the next open;
the exit target (0.50) is set at the last window session's close and filled at
the next open.

The delivered centre is (base_weight=0.50, window=last2+first2).  The 8-cell
pre-registered grid, including the shifted +5-session placebo, is in
HYPOTHESIS.md.  No 2024+ bar is loaded.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "research"))
import bt  # noqa: E402

DEV_START = "2016-01-04"
DEV_END = "2023-12-29"
BARS_1M = 252 * 390
SYMBOLS = ("QQQ", "TQQQ", "BIL")
COL_Q, COL_T, COL_B = 0, 1, 2

# pre-registered centre
BASE_W = 0.50
WINDOW_N = 2

BAR = {"cagr": 0.3672, "max_drawdown": 0.8229, "sharpe": 0.82}
PANEL_BAR = {"cagr": 0.3629, "max_drawdown": 0.8157, "sharpe": 0.80}

WINNERS = (
    "ratio-froth", "vol-scaled-crash-stop", "relative-value-tqqq",
    "fomc-opex-window", "family-session-timing", "family-short-reversal",
    "family-rebalance-flow", "family-intraday-microstructure-day",
    "family-ml-microstructure",
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# calendar and weights
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def calendar(ts):
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    nd = len(first)
    sd = pd.to_datetime(pd.Series(dates[first]))
    month = sd.dt.month.to_numpy()
    year = sd.dt.year.to_numpy()
    month_id = year * 100 + month
    sim = np.zeros(nd, dtype=int)
    prev = None
    cnt = 0
    for k in range(nd):
        key = month_id[k]
        if key != prev:
            cnt = 0
            prev = key
        sim[k] = cnt
        cnt += 1
    nsm = pd.Series(sim).groupby(month_id).transform("max").to_numpy() + 1
    return {"dates": dates, "first": first, "last": last, "nd": nd,
            "month": month, "year": year, "month_id": month_id,
            "sim": sim, "nsm": nsm, "sfe": nsm - 1 - sim,
            "qend": np.isin(month, [3, 6, 9, 12]),
            "qstart": np.isin(month, [1, 4, 7, 10])}


def window_mask(cal, n=WINDOW_N):
    return ((cal["qend"] & (cal["sfe"] <= n - 1))
            | (cal["qstart"] & (cal["sim"] <= n - 1)))


def shifted_mask(mask, shift):
    out = np.zeros(len(mask), dtype=bool)
    idx = np.flatnonzero(mask)
    out[np.clip(idx + shift, 0, len(mask) - 1)] = True
    return out


def weights_from_target(ts, first, last, nd, target, idle_bil=True):
    w = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    for k in range(nd):
        f, l = int(first[k]), int(last[k])
        x = float(target[k])
        w[f:l, COL_T] = x
        if idle_bil:
            w[f:l, COL_B] = 1.0 - x
        xn = float(target[k + 1]) if k + 1 < nd else x
        w[l, COL_T] = xn
        if idle_bil:
            w[l, COL_B] = 1.0 - xn
    assert w.min() >= -1e-12, "negative weight"
    assert np.all(w.sum(axis=1) <= 1.0 + 1e-9), "weights sum > 1"
    return w


def build_weights_params(ts, o, c, base=BASE_W, window="both", shift=0,
                         idle_bil=True):
    cal = calendar(ts)
    if window == "both":
        mask = window_mask(cal)
    elif window == "last":
        mask = cal["qend"] & (cal["sfe"] <= WINDOW_N - 1)
    elif window == "first":
        mask = cal["qstart"] & (cal["sim"] <= WINDOW_N - 1)
    elif window == "only":
        mask = window_mask(cal)
    else:
        raise ValueError(window)
    if shift:
        mask = shifted_mask(mask, shift)
    target = np.where(mask, 1.0, base)
    if window == "only":
        target = mask.astype(float)
    return weights_from_target(ts, cal["first"], cal["last"], cal["nd"],
                               target, idle_bil=idle_bil)


def build_weights(ts, o, c):
    """Pre-registered centre."""
    return build_weights_params(ts, o, c)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# evaluation helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def pack(s):
    keys = ("cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "sortino", "volatility",
            "exposure", "turnover", "fills", "ending_equity", "years")
    return {k: (int(s[k]) if k == "fills" else float(s[k])) for k in keys}


def run_weights(ts, o, c, w, slip=1.0, start=DEV_START):
    res = bt.run(ts, o, c, w, start, band=0.02, slippage_bps=slip)
    return res, bt.stats(res, BARS_1M)


def daily_equity(res):
    s = pd.Series(res["equity"], index=res["ts"])
    d = s.groupby(res["ts"].date).last()
    d.index = pd.to_datetime(d.index)
    return d


def annual_returns(de, start_equity=100_000.0):
    out = {}
    prev = start_equity
    for year in range(2016, 2024):
        x = de[de.index.year == year]
        if len(x) == 0:
            continue
        out[str(year)] = float(x.iloc[-1] / prev - 1.0)
        prev = x.iloc[-1]
    return out


def subperiod(de, lo, hi):
    x = de[(de.index >= lo) & (de.index <= hi)]
    if len(x) < 2:
        return None
    years = (x.index[-1] - x.index[0]).days / 365.25
    return {"cagr": float((x.iloc[-1] / x.iloc[0]) ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(x / x.cummax() - 1).min()),
            "years": float(years)}


def dd_window(ts, equity):
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(equity)
    dd = equity / peak - 1.0
    j = int(np.argmin(dd))
    i = int(np.argmax(equity[: j + 1]))
    return {"peak": str(ts[i])[:10], "trough": str(ts[j])[:10],
            "dd": float(-dd[j])}


def daily_frame(ts, o, c):
    cal = calendar(ts)
    first, last, nd = cal["first"], cal["last"], cal["nd"]
    t_open = np.asarray(o)[first, COL_T]
    t_close = np.asarray(c)[last, COL_T]
    b_open = np.asarray(o)[first, COL_B]
    q_close = np.asarray(c)[last, COL_Q]
    t_oo = np.r_[t_open[1:] / t_open[:-1] - 1.0, 0.0]
    b_oo = np.r_[b_open[1:] / b_open[:-1] - 1.0, 0.0]
    q_oo = np.r_[q_close[1:] / q_close[:-1] - 1.0, 0.0]
    return {"cal": cal, "t_oo": t_oo, "b_oo": b_oo, "q_oo": q_oo}


def daily_cagr(frac, frame, idle_bil=True):
    r = frac * frame["t_oo"]
    if idle_bil:
        r = r + (1.0 - frac) * frame["b_oo"]
    eq = np.cumprod(1.0 + r)
    years = len(r) / 252.0
    return float(eq[-1] ** (1 / years) - 1.0)


def stat(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    n = len(x)
    if n < 2:
        return {"n": int(n), "mean_bp": float("nan"), "t": float("nan"),
                "win": float("nan")}
    return {"n": int(n), "mean_bp": float(np.mean(x) * 1e4),
            "t": float(np.mean(x) / (np.std(x, ddof=0) / np.sqrt(n))),
            "win": float((x > 0).mean())}


def correlation_to_winners(r):
    out = {}
    for slug in WINNERS:
        path = ROOT / "research" / "new" / "curves" / f"{slug}.json"
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        idx = pd.to_datetime(d["dates"])
        v = pd.Series(d["values"], index=idx)
        v = v[v.index <= pd.Timestamp(DEV_END)]
        rr = v.pct_change().dropna()
        j = pd.concat([r, rr], axis=1, join="inner").dropna()
        out[slug] = float(j.iloc[:, 0].corr(j.iloc[:, 1]))
    vals = np.array(list(out.values()))
    return {"by_slug": out, "min": float(vals.min()),
            "max": float(vals.max()), "mean": float(vals.mean())}


def causality_check(ts, o, c, builder):
    j = bt.start_index(ts, "2022-01-03")
    j2 = bt.start_index(ts, "2021-12-30")
    w_trunc = builder(ts[:j], o[:j], c[:j])
    w_full = builder(ts, o, c)
    return {"truncation_date": "2022-01-03", "compare_through": "2021-12-29",
            "prior_weights_unchanged": bool(np.allclose(w_trunc[:j2], w_full[:j2]))}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def main():
    ts, o, c = bt.panel(SYMBOLS, DEV_START, DEV_END, "1min", warmup_days=5)
    cal = calendar(ts)
    frame = daily_frame(ts, o, c)
    nd = cal["nd"]
    print(f"panel {len(ts):,} bars, {nd} sessions, "
          f"{ts[0].date()} .. {ts[-1].date()}")

    w = build_weights(ts, o, c)
    i0 = bt.start_index(ts, DEV_START)
    bench_bars = np.asarray(c)[i0:, COL_T]
    bench = bt.benchmark(bench_bars, ts[i0:], BARS_1M)

    out = {
        "strategy": "family-quarter-end-flow",
        "directory": "research/new/family-quarter-end-flow",
        "window": {"start": DEV_START, "end": DEV_END, "marks": "1m",
                   "fills": "next open, 2% band", "idle": "BIL"},
        "rules": {
            "clock": "calendar quarter: last 2 sessions of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec "
                     "plus first 2 sessions of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct",
            "base_weight": BASE_W,
            "window_weight": 1.00,
            "window_sessions": 2,
            "bar": BAR,
            "panel_bar": PANEL_BAR,
        },
        "dev": {},
    }

    results = {}
    for slip in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
        res, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, w, slip=slip)
        results[slip] = (res, s)
        out["dev"][f"{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(s)
        print(f"centre {slip:2.0f}bp  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:4.2f}  "
              f"fills {s['fills']:,}  turnover {s['turnover']:.0f}  "
              f"exposure {s['exposure']*100:.1f}%")

    res1, s1 = results[1.0]
    out["benchmark_tqqq"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in bench.items()}
    out["benchmark_tqqq"]["symbol"] = "TQQQ"
    out["benchmark_tqqq"]["bar_from_brief"] = BAR
    print(f"bench  CAGR {bench['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  DD {bench['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
          f"Sharpe {bench['sharpe']:4.2f}")

    wbar = w[:, COL_T]
    wsess = w[cal["first"], COL_T]
    out["exposure"] = {
        "mean_tqqq_weight_bar": float(wbar.mean()),
        "mean_tqqq_weight_session": float(wsess.mean()),
        "fraction_sessions_full": float((wsess > 0.99).mean()),
        "fraction_sessions_base": float((np.abs(wsess - BASE_W) < 1e-9).mean()),
        "mean_bil_weight": float(w[:, COL_B].mean()),
        "stats_exposure_incl_bil": float(s1["exposure"]),
    }
    print("exposure", {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in out["exposure"].items()})

    de = daily_equity(res1)
    r = de.pct_change().dropna()
    out["yearly"] = {
        y: {"strategy": v,
            "benchmark": float(bt.yearly(res1["ts"], res1["equity"],
                                         bench_bars)[int(y)]["benchmark"])}
        for y, v in annual_returns(de).items()
    }
    out["dd_window"] = dd_window(res1["ts"], res1["equity"])
    out["subperiods"] = {
        "2016_2019": subperiod(de, "2016-01-04", "2019-12-31"),
        "2020_2023": subperiod(de, "2020-01-02", "2023-12-29"),
    }
    ex = de[de.index.year != 2020]
    yrs = (ex.index[-1] - ex.index[0]).days / 365.25
    out["ex2020"] = {"cagr": float((ex.iloc[-1] / ex.iloc[0]) ** (1 / yrs) - 1),
                     "max_drawdown": float(-(ex / ex.cummax() - 1).min())}

    # ---- window diagnostics -------------------------------------------------
    win = window_mask(cal)
    diag = {"window": stat(frame["t_oo"][win]),
            "outside": stat(frame["t_oo"][~win]),
            "window_qqq": stat(frame["q_oo"][win]),
            "outside_qqq": stat(frame["q_oo"][~win])}
    for n in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5):
        last = cal["qend"] & (cal["sfe"] <= n - 1)
        first = cal["qstart"] & (cal["sim"] <= n - 1)
        diag[f"last{n}"] = stat(frame["t_oo"][last])
        diag[f"first{n}"] = stat(frame["t_oo"][first])
    for shift in (5, -5):
        m = shifted_mask(win, shift)
        diag[f"shift{shift:+d}"] = stat(frame["t_oo"][m])
    out["window_diagnostics"] = diag
    print("window diagnostics")
    for k, v in diag.items():
        print(f"  {k:10s} n={v['n']:4d} mean={v['mean_bp']:+7.1f}bp t={v['t']:+5.2f}")

    # by quarter (window vs outside)
    by_q = []
    for q in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        m = win & (cal["month"].astype(int) % 3 == q % 3)
        # quarter-end month map: Q1->Mar, Q2->Jun, Q3->Sep, Q4->Dec
        qm = {1: 3, 2: 6, 3: 9, 4: 12}[q]
        sel = win & ((cal["month"] == qm) |
                     ((cal["month"] == qm % 12 + 1) & (cal["sim"] <= 1)))
        by_q.append({"quarter": q, **stat(frame["t_oo"][sel])})
    out["window_by_quarter"] = by_q
    print("window by quarter", [(d["quarter"], round(d["mean_bp"], 1)) for d in by_q])

    # ---- pre-registered grid (8 cells) --------------------------------------
    grid_spec = [
        (0.30, "both", 0, "base neighbour"),
        (0.50, "both", 0, "centre"),
        (0.70, "both", 0, "base neighbour"),
        (0.90, "both", 0, "base neighbour"),
        (0.50, "last", 0, "window neighbour"),
        (0.50, "first", 0, "window neighbour"),
        (0.50, "both", 5, "placebo +5 sessions"),
        (0.00, "only", 0, "window-only"),
    ]
    grid = []
    for base, mode, shift, role in grid_spec:
        wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, base=base, window=mode, shift=shift)
        _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
        _, s10 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=10.0)
        grid.append({"base_weight": base, "window_mode": mode, "shift": shift,
                     "role": role, **pack(s), "ten_bp": pack(s10)})
        print(f"grid base={base:.2f} win={mode:5s} shift={shift:+d} {role:20s} "
              f"1bp CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
              f"Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}  10bp CAGR {s10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")
    out["grid"] = grid

    # ---- controls -----------------------------------------------------------
    controls = {}
    wt = weights_from_target(ts, cal["first"], cal["last"], nd,
                             np.ones(nd), idle_bil=True)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["tqqq_buy_hold"] = pack(s)
    print(f"control TQQQ               CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}")

    mean_w = float(wbar.mean())
    wt = weights_from_target(ts, cal["first"], cal["last"], nd,
                             np.full(nd, mean_w), idle_bil=True)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["constant_exposure_same_mean"] = {**pack(s), "weight": mean_w}
    print(f"control constant {mean_w:.3f}    CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}")

    wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, base=0.5, window="both", shift=-5)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["window_shift_minus5"] = pack(s)
    print(f"control shift -5 sessions  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}")

    # rejected negative-flow direction: de-risk the last 2 sessions
    target = np.where(cal["qend"] & (cal["sfe"] <= 1), 0.0, 1.0)
    wt = weights_from_target(ts, cal["first"], cal["last"], nd, target,
                             idle_bil=True)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["derisk_last2_sessions"] = pack(s)
    print(f"control de-risk last2      CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}")

    # conditional alternative: de-risk first 2 after an up quarter

    def prev_month_id(mid, back):
        y, m = divmod(mid, 100)
        m -= back
        while m <= 0:
            m += 12
            y -= 1
        return y * 100 + m

    target = np.ones(nd)
    for k in range(1, nd):
        if cal["sim"][k] <= 1 and cal["qstart"][k]:
            # prior quarter = the three month blocks before this quarter
            prior = [prev_month_id(cal["month_id"][k], j) for j in (3, 2, 1)]
            m = np.isin(cal["month_id"], prior)
            if m.any() and frame["q_oo"][m].sum() > 0:
                target[k] = 0.0
    wt = weights_from_target(ts, cal["first"], cal["last"], nd, target,
                             idle_bil=True)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["derisk_first2_after_up_quarter"] = pack(s)
    print(f"control conditional upQ    CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}")
    out["controls"] = controls

    # ---- placebos -----------------------------------------------------------
    real_daily = daily_cagr(np.where(win, 1.0, BASE_W), frame, idle_bil=True)
    out["placebo_shifted"] = {
        "real_daily_cagr": float(real_daily),
        "plus5_daily_cagr": float(daily_cagr(
            np.where(shifted_mask(win, 5), 1.0, BASE_W), frame, idle_bil=True)),
        "minus5_daily_cagr": float(daily_cagr(
            np.where(shifted_mask(win, -5), 1.0, BASE_W), frame, idle_bil=True)),
    }
    print("shifted placebo", out["placebo_shifted"])

    # random 4-session windows, same number of windows
    n_windows = int(np.sum(cal["qend"] & (cal["sfe"] == 1)))
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261127)
    draws = []
    for _ in range(1000):
        mask = np.zeros(nd, dtype=bool)
        starts = rng.choice(max(nd - 4, 1), n_windows, replace=False)
        for st in starts:
            mask[st:st + 4] = True
        draws.append(daily_cagr(np.where(mask, 1.0, BASE_W), frame,
                                idle_bil=True))
    draws = np.array(draws)
    out["placebo"] = {
        "n_draws": int(len(draws)), "marks": "1D open-to-open",
        "n_windows": n_windows,
        "real_daily_cagr": float(real_daily),
        "real_1m_cagr_1bp": float(s1["cagr"]),
        "mean": float(draws.mean()),
        "p95": float(np.quantile(draws, 0.95)),
        "p99": float(np.quantile(draws, 0.99)),
        "max": float(draws.max()),
        "p_value": float((draws >= real_daily).mean()),
    }
    print("placebo", {k: (round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v)
                      for k, v in out["placebo"].items()})

    # ---- correlations -------------------------------------------------------
    out["correlation"] = correlation_to_winners(r)
    print("corr winners min %.3f max %.3f mean %.3f" % (
        out["correlation"]["min"], out["correlation"]["max"],
        out["correlation"]["mean"]))
    print("corr", {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in out["correlation"]["by_slug"].items()})

    # ---- causality ----------------------------------------------------------
    out["causality"] = causality_check(ts, o, c, build_weights)
    print("causality", out["causality"])

    # ---- kill criteria ------------------------------------------------------
    dev10 = out["dev"]["10bp"]
    c1 = dev10["cagr"] <= BAR["cagr"]
    shift_cell = [g for g in grid if g["role"] == "placebo +5 sessions"][0]
    c2 = shift_cell["cagr"] > s1["cagr"]
    window_only = [g for g in grid if g["role"] == "window-only"][0]
    c3 = window_only["cagr"] < 0.05
    c4 = diag["window"]["t"] < 1.0
    const = controls["constant_exposure_same_mean"]
    c5 = s1["cagr"] <= const["cagr"]
    # c6: remove the best quarter and compare with the same daily constant model
    q_best = max(by_q, key=lambda d: d["mean_bp"])
    qm = {1: 3, 2: 6, 3: 9, 4: 12}[q_best["quarter"]]
    drop = win & ((cal["month"] == qm) |
                  ((cal["month"] == qm % 12 + 1) & (cal["sim"] <= 1)))
    f_drop = np.where(drop, 0.0, np.where(win, 1.0, BASE_W))
    const_daily = daily_cagr(np.full(nd, mean_w), frame, idle_bil=True)
    c6 = daily_cagr(f_drop, frame, idle_bil=True) < const_daily
    kills = {
        "c1_10bp_cagr_below_bar": bool(c1),
        "c2_shifted_placebo_beats_real": bool(c2),
        "c3_window_only_below_5pct": bool(c3),
        "c4_window_mean_t_below_1": bool(c4),
        "c5_below_constant_exposure": bool(c5),
        "c6_drop_best_quarter_below_constant": bool(c6),
    }
    out["kill_criteria"] = kills
    out["verdict"] = "negative" if any(kills.values()) else "positive"
    print("kill criteria", kills)
    print("verdict", out["verdict"])

    (HERE / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=float))
    print("wrote", HERE / "result.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
